text: The Villa Meesuk is an assisted living residence. The project's first phase includes 29 condos and 5 villa residence. On the premise is an activity center and clinic. The residence is approximately 5 minutes away from the hospital for emergency care. Each unit pays an association fee to upkeep the property.  Villa Meesuk is a great assisted facility.

My parents have been residents here for 5 months, and as Americans for the last 50 years- they like their creature comforts. All staff is excellent and has treated them like their own family- with tons of respect and patience. I flew here from Los Angeles to check it out for myself and I wouldn’t mind retiring here!
I feel safe and sound here.

This is a pioneering elderly care facility in Chiang Mai province, run by Dr. Daeng, a retired medical professor and doctor from Maharaj Nakorn Chiang Mai Hospital. The facility is clean and spacious.
A place for the elderly with a team of caregivers.
Villa Meesuk Residences is one of the best senior care facilities in Chiang Mai. Here, your loved ones are cared for with the utmost love and attention, giving you complete peace of mind.
Ideal for seniors looking for a home or accommodation with caregiver and utilities.
